# Phase-0 repair re-review: APPROVE

**Verdict: APPROVE for phase 0.** All five repairs held against a discriminating probe, and every probe had a clean positive control. I found no new failure that has a concrete counterexample.

The reviewed files were identical before and after the review, going by `sha256sum`:
- `runner.py` `2425e95028edd13a4a43e49fc99904ce695b0b98aafe6d277124b1b169b5c49d`
- `rate_oracle.py` `afb3a535fe95dc99cba444a401730a8d79a69f2aabf1c9b7bf3e5c2724c603c6`
- `workload.py` `3b01fd5bced3ca6d67bd946e7c24ed0a4998292da222da2be7a69c771f341457`

Every probe was an inline `python3 -B -c` run in a fresh `target/alpha-claude-r2-*` directory, all under 1 MB. Total executable time was about 25 s.

| Repair | Negative probe → observed | Positive control → observed |
|---|---|---|
| Detached (`setsid`) child containment | Detached child sleeps 30 s, leader exits → `orphan_descendant`, `passed=False`, `cleanup_ok=True`, child not alive after return | A detached child that finishes before the leader exits → `passed=True` |
| SIGTERM-ignoring cleanup | Detached child ignores SIGTERM, leader exits → `orphan_descendant`, dead after 0.79 s. Same child with a 0.8 s time limit → `duration_limit`, dead after 1.33 s | After the runs the probe has no child processes, and its subreaper flag is back to 0 |
| Stale `offered.csv`/`offers.jsonl` | A no-op rerun in the same directory with a rate contract → `rate_contract` "missing … rate file", `passed=False`; both old files deleted before launch | A real tier-10, 2 s workload run → `passed=True`, `source_seed=0xa11fa003` |
| Stale result invalidation | After a passing run: a nonexistent executable raises `FileNotFoundError`, and `result.json` = `in_progress`, `passed=False`. A rerun that creates a symlink mid-run crashes, and `result.json` = `in_progress`, `passed=False` | A passing run between the two failures leaves `result.json` with `passed=True` |
| Rapid temp-file churn | 6,120–19,767 create/delete cycles of 100 B files in `TMPDIR` and in a subdirectory → all `passed=True`, no crash | Control: a persistent 100 kB file against a 2000 B budget → `disk_limit` |
| Exact seeded contents | All rejected: one flipped character in an entropy body, an entropy body from seed 2, metric value +1, a metric from seed 2, a swapped metric point, one changed character in a repetitive body, an extra field, a duplicate JSON key | Unmodified seed-1 file → `0xa11fa001`; a complete seed-2 file → `0xa11fa002`; a paced seed-3 run → `0xa11fa003` |
| Owned `TMPDIR` | A 200 kB persistent tempfile against a 5000 B budget → `disk_limit`. A symlinked `tmp` directory is rejected before launch and the command does not run | A 100 B tempfile passes, and the child's temp directory is `<root>/tmp` |

## Probe errors and permission denials
- **My own probe errors (not code defects):**
  - One case used a text replace of `IGN` that also matched `SIG_IGN`, so that case never ran its check. I re-ran it correctly; it is the second containment row.
  - One corruption probe used the wrong record indices. An assertion stopped it before any verdict was printed, and I re-ran it with the right indices.
- **Denied:**
  - A `timeout …; echo` wrapper around a probe. I resubmitted it in the plain allowed form.
  - Deleting my probe directories. I did not retry.
  - A scan of other processes' `/proc/*/environ` for leftover invocation tokens. I did not retry.

## Open items
- **Leftover live processes: not fully verified.** The in-probe scans found no child processes. But for the aborted containment case above, the runner returned and cleaned up without its result being printed, and the full token scan was denied. For you to run:
  `python3 -B -c 'import os;u=os.getuid();print([p for p in os.listdir("/proc") if p.isdigit() and os.path.exists("/proc/"+p) and os.stat("/proc/"+p).st_uid==u and os.access("/proc/%s/environ"%p,os.R_OK) and b"\0FABRIC_ALPHA_INVOCATION=" in b"\0"+open("/proc/%s/environ"%p,"rb").read()])'`
  It should print `[]`.
- **Probe directories not cleaned up.** All `target/alpha-claude-*` directories from both review rounds remain; they are git-ignored and small.
  - Remove the symlink `target/alpha-claude-r2-P2-*/lnk` first, or `clear_owned` will refuse that directory.
  - After that, `clear_owned` can remove every directory with an ownership marker.
  - Three first-round directories have no marker (`*-D8-sibling-*`, `*-E1-sibling-*`, `*-S8-sib-*`). Each should hold only a single `outside.bin` or `o.bin` file; remove them by hand.
